# Basic add - cron + oneshot - and verify they land in ls/show.

exec reloop add --cron '@hourly' --name backup -- echo hi
stdout 'added job [0-9A-Za-z]+ \(cron, @hourly\)'

exec reloop add --at '+1h' --name morning -- echo wake
stdout 'added job [0-9A-Za-z]+ \(oneshot, at .*\)'

# Name defaults to the command when --name is omitted.
exec reloop add --cron '@daily' -- /bin/echo from-cmd
stdout 'added job [0-9A-Za-z]+'

# Three jobs created - verify by name (IDs are random 5-char strings).
exec reloop ls --json
stdout '"name": "backup"'
stdout '"name": "morning"'
stdout '"cron": "@hourly"'

# Show resolves by name.
exec reloop show backup --json
stdout '"kind": "cron"'

exec reloop show morning --json
stdout '"kind": "oneshot"'
stdout '"fire_at"'
